summary: CLI tự động hóa điều khiển trình duyệt cho AI agent, cho phép tự động hóa tác vụ web thông qua dòng lệnh.
usecases: AI agents performing autonomous web research or data collection tasks.
Automated testing of web applications through browser interaction scripts.
Headless browser operations for machine learning data preprocessing.
ideas: Integrate with LangChain frameworks for autonomous web navigation agents.
Add built-in proxy/VPN rotation support for distributed scraping and anonymity.
Develop a real-time visual dashboard to monitor and debug agent browser actions.
